summary: Requires Errand 0.4.2 or later. Reviews job execution (any operand-bearing invocation) and `fetch --apply`; flag-only and help invocations remain automatic. Conservative port of the v1 detector: declarative matchers cannot exclude known read-only subcommands, so operand-bearing calls like `errand ps` also review.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the reviewed operations and the surrounding Guard policy.
A maintainer profile is not a security certification or an official upstream endorsement.
